title: Carrier Onboarding Log Form
subtitle: Carrier Onboarding: preserves changes and next triggers.
description: Carrier Onboarding Log Form covers carrier organization, operating authority, insurance, contacts, equipment, controls, and approval. The carrier onboarding coordinator records Carrier Onboarding events, owners, exceptions, and next triggers. Carrier Onboarding Log Form keeps Carrier Onboarding exceptions visible until the carrier onboarding coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Carrier Onboarding Log Form at carrier file, qualification system, dispatch access, and document repository. Document carrier organization, operating authority, insurance, contacts, equipment, controls, and approval identity before Carrier Onboarding begins. Compare carrier organization, operating authority, insurance, contacts, equipment, controls, and approval findings with stated Carrier Onboarding criteria; route unresolved Carrier Onboarding issues to authorized carrier-compliance reviewer. For Carrier Onboarding Log Form, confirm requirements for Carrier Onboarding. Ask authorized carrier-compliance reviewer to review Carrier Onboarding conditions beyond the carrier onboarding coordinator's role.

sections.title: Tracking review and responsible owner
sections.guidance: For Carrier Onboarding, identify responsible parties, carrier file, qualification system, dispatch access, and document repository, and the linked carrier organization, operating authority, insurance, contacts, equipment, controls, and approval source.

fields.label: Authority, tax, insurance, and vendor identifiers
Dispatch, safety, claims, billing, and after-hours contacts

sections.title: Tracking review and variance evidence
sections.guidance: Capture Carrier Onboarding facts for carrier organization, operating authority, insurance, contacts, equipment, controls, and approval; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Carrier Onboarding tracked controls
items: Insurance type, limit, term, and source
Safety, security, tracking, and cargo controls
Payment, fraud, identity, and communication verification
Approval scope, conditions, expiration, and re-review

sections.title: Tracking exception, status, and next update
sections.guidance: Reconcile the latest Carrier Onboarding event before closeout. Carrier Onboarding Coordinator identifies overdue action, the responsible party, and the event that reopens review.

blocks.label: Status exceptions, overdue actions, and retained evidence
items: Identity or ownership cannot be verified
blocks.guidance: Pause Carrier Onboarding when carrier identity, authority, insurance, fraud control, or authorized approval remains unresolved. Retain the available Carrier Onboarding proof and route unresolved carrier organization, operating authority, insurance, contacts, equipment, controls, and approval scope to carrier onboarding coordinator.
